whoWeAre: Jumbo Sales is a Kenyan hardware and construction materials supplier, built to make sourcing quality building materials simple and reliable. We work directly with customers across the country — from individual homeowners putting up a single room to contractors managing full construction sites — supplying the materials that projects are actually built with: mabati, water tanks, steel and general hardware.
whatWeSupply: Our core range covers three areas customers ask for most: mabati and iron sheets in corrugated, box profile and tile profile styles across multiple gauges and colours; water storage tanks from 1,000 to 20,000 litres; and steel products including reinforcement bars, hollow sections and angle bars in a range of sizes. We are continually adding new product lines as customer demand grows, so if you need something specific that isn't listed yet, reach out — we likely stock it or can source it.
whyChooseUs: We built this business around three things customers consistently told us mattered most: straightforward pricing you can see before you call, real product photos instead of stock images so you know exactly what you're ordering, and a simple way to reach us — one WhatsApp message away, whether that's placing an order, asking about stock, or requesting a delivery quote. We serve customers countrywide and coordinate delivery based on your specific location, order size and the products you need.
mission: To make quality construction and hardware materials genuinely accessible to every builder in Kenya — from first-time homeowners to established contractors — through fair pricing, honest product information, and service that respects people's time and money.
vision: To grow into one of the most trusted names in hardware and construction supply in Kenya, known as much for reliability and straight dealing as for the range of materials we carry.
